summary: Iteration 3 backend retest after fixes claimed in iter-2 report. 52/53 tests PASS (32 iter-1 + 14 iter-2 + 6/7 iter-3). All five new ProviderProfileIn fields (is_home_based, latitude, longitude, additional_categories, gallery) now persist correctly on BOTH POST /api/providers and PUT /api/providers/me — verified via response + GET re-read. Unique indexes confirmed on provider_profiles.slug, provider_profiles.user_id, users.email — duplicate email registration now correctly rejected with 4xx. Only one provider_profiles doc exists for demo slug (no drift). Full messaging round-trip, upload+files, gallery add/remove, plan change, users/me update all green. ONE FAILURE: demo provider eCard gallery has 0 items, NOT 3 — the main agent's claimed fix (c) 'seed idempotent by provider_profiles slug' was NOT applied: server.py line 316 still gates the entire demo-provider seed block on `if not await db.users.find_one({email:'demo.provider@getmano.com'})`. Because the demo user already existed from a prior iteration, the rewrite of the provider_profiles insert (which now contains the 3 gallery items g_seed1/2/3) NEVER ran on restart. Net result: existing demo profile has gallery=[].

minor.issue: Demo provider gallery items (g_seed1/g_seed2/g_seed3) not present in DB (gallery=[]). Root cause: seed block is gated by `db.users.find_one({email:'demo.provider@getmano.com'})` — since the user already existed, the new provider_profiles insert (with 3 gallery items) was skipped. Fix needs to either (a) check `db.provider_profiles.find_one({slug: DEMO_SLUG})` and upsert gallery if missing, or (b) delete-then-reseed demo provider profile, or (c) run a one-shot migration that $set's gallery on the existing demo doc. Main agent's iter-2 claim that 'seed is now idempotent by slug' is NOT reflected in the committed code.

action_items: Make the demo-provider seed idempotent by slug (not by user existence) — currently the gallery items code path is dead for any DB where the demo user already exists. Suggested patch: replace `if not await db.users.find_one({...demo.provider...})` with separate checks: ensure user exists OR insert; THEN `if not await db.provider_profiles.find_one({slug: DEMO_SLUG})` insert profile; ELSE `$set` gallery on the existing doc when it's empty.
(Carryover, low priority) seed demo with non-empty gallery so frontend eCard gallery section renders for visitors — directly fixed by the action above.
(Carryover from iter-2) add data-testid attributes to /register form fields for E2E automation.
(Carryover from iter-2) validate gallery URL is http(s) or /api/files/ to prevent javascript: XSS.

rca_of_issue: DEMO PROVIDER GALLERY EMPTY: server.py:316 wraps user creation + provider_profile creation + gallery insertion inside a single `if not await db.users.find_one({email:'demo.provider@getmano.com'})` block. On a DB where the demo user already exists from any prior iteration (which is the case here — user_dd013c7efcff has existed since iter-2), the entire block — including the new code that inserts gallery items g_seed1/2/3 — is skipped. The existing provider_profiles doc retains its original gallery=[] from when it was first created. Mitigation: do NOT bundle user-existence and profile-existence checks together; check each collection independently and upsert profile.gallery when the profile exists but gallery is empty. Alternative one-shot fix: `db.provider_profiles.update_one({slug:'maria-cleaning-services-sallisaw-ok'}, {'$set': {'gallery': [g_seed1,g_seed2,g_seed3]}})` in a migration script.
